### Data Science {.about-title .glyph-chart-dots}

I study human behavior in transportation systems using discrete choice models and scenario simulation, focusing on smart charging [adoption](/research/2024-sc-adoption) and [economy](/research/2025-smc-economy) to generate policy suggestions for policymakers and utilities.

### Open-Source Software {.about-title .glyph-package}

I develop open-source {{< var rnolink >}} tools for survey design and discrete choice modeling, including [`<span class="about-tool-mark"><img src="resources/images/logo-surveydown.png" alt=""></span>`{=html}surveydown](/research/2024-surveydown){.about-tool}, a programmable, markdown-based survey platform built on [[]{.glyph .glyph-quarto aria-hidden="true"}Quarto](https://quarto.org/){.about-tool}, [[]{.glyph .glyph-r aria-hidden="true"}Shiny](https://shiny.posit.co/){.about-tool}, and [[]{.glyph .glyph-database aria-hidden="true"}PostgreSQL](https://supabase.com){.about-tool}, and its companion GUI [`<span class="about-tool-mark"><img src="resources/images/logo-sdstudio.png" alt=""></span>`{=html}sdstudio](/research/2025-sdstudio){.about-tool}.

### Agentic AI Engineering {.about-title .glyph-sparkles}

I build software with agentic workflows around [[]{.glyph .glyph-anthropic aria-hidden="true"}Claude Code](https://www.anthropic.com/claude-code){.about-tool} and [[]{.glyph .glyph-openai aria-hidden="true"}Codex](https://openai.com/codex/){.about-tool}, extending them with skills, MCP servers, and hooks. I write [tutorials](/blog/2026-03-26-agentic-engineering-1) and share my own [workflows](/blog/2026-05-15-agentic-workflows) on the blog, and run a [workshop](https://pingfan-hu.github.io/2026-agentic-workshop/) at [GW TAI](https://trustworthyai.gwu.edu) for researchers and developers.

With Professor Helveston, I run [`<span class="about-tool-mark"><img src="resources/images/logo-alkaline.png" alt=""></span>`{=html}Alkaline Software](https://github.com/alkaline-software){.about-tool}, an app development studio, where we build desktop apps in Rust with [GPUI](https://www.gpui.rs) using the same workflows. Our flagship product is [`<span class="about-tool-mark"><img src="resources/images/logo-emaki.png" alt=""></span>`{=html}Emaki](https://emaki.lol){.about-tool}, an Agentic Development Environment (ADE).
